title: Client Profile - Nordhaven Goods
markdown:
## Account
Nordhaven Goods sells outdoor gear through our marketplace. The account opened in 2024 and runs about 900 orders a month. The billing contact is R. Vellani, finance lead.

## Service terms
Nordhaven is on the standard service tier. They get email support inside working hours. Returns follow the general policy with no client specific changes.

## Preferences
They want delivery updates sent to the operations alias, not to individual buyers. They ask for a short written summary at the end of every escalation.

title: Client Profile - Pellcroft Supply Co
markdown:
## Account
Pellcroft Supply Co supplies components to independent workshops. The account opened in 2023 and runs about 300 orders a month. The operations contact is D. Marrow, warehouse manager.

## Service terms
Pellcroft is on the priority tier. Their orders skip the standard packing queue. Escalations get a reply inside two working hours.

## Preferences
They require proof of delivery on every shipment. They reject partial shipments and prefer to wait for a full pick.

title: Client Profile - Bramblewick Retail
markdown:
## Account
Bramblewick Retail runs homeware stores and an online shop. The account opened in 2022 and runs about 2,000 orders a month. The contact is S. Okonkwo, head of ecommerce.

## Service terms
Bramblewick is on the priority tier with a named account manager. They have a contractual escalation path that ends with their managing director.

## Preferences
They want weekly stock reports every Friday. They never accept a substitute item on a backorder.

title: Client Profile - Quayside Direct
markdown:
## Account
Quayside Direct sells marine spares to boat owners. The account opened in 2025 and runs about 450 orders a month. The contact is L. Ferreira, purchasing officer.

## Service terms
Quayside Direct is on the standard service tier. Email support inside working hours. Chargeback responses are handled with their own evidence pack template.

## Preferences
They ask for serial numbers on every packing slip. They want the carrier named in every shipping update.

title: Client Profile - Marrowfield Outfitters
markdown:
## Account
Marrowfield Outfitters sells workwear to trade customers. The account opened in 2024 and runs about 700 orders a month. The contact is J. Aldridge, operations director.

## Service terms
Marrowfield is on the priority tier. Split shipments are allowed and expected on trade orders. Returns above 500 units of currency need their written approval first.

## Preferences
They want invoices sent on the day of dispatch. They ask for a named contact on every escalation.

title: Client Profile - Tindale Homewares
markdown:
## Account
Tindale Homewares is a single site retailer with an online shop. The account opened in 2025 and runs about 150 orders a month. The contact is P. Nkemelu, owner.

## Service terms
Tindale Homewares is on the standard service tier. They use the shared support inbox. Their volume is low, so nothing is scheduled or automated for them.

## Preferences
They prefer a phone call for anything urgent. They want refunds issued to the original card only, never as store credit.
